description: This PHP source file defines the CandidateService class within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It provides constants for recruitment status and actions, maps workflow states to descriptive statuses, and includes a method to access the CandidateDao object for database interactions related to candidates.

classes.name: CandidateService
classes.description: Service class providing recruitment candidate operations, constants, and workflow status mappings.

methods.description: Returns an instance of CandidateDao, initializing it if necessary.
